svg.title: SimLM tier 2 with document processing
svg.desc: Offline, an LLM reads source documents and produces Q&A pairs that an admin reviews; each approved question is embedded by a sentence model and stored as a vector in pgvector. At runtime, the query is embedded by the same model, matched by nearest neighbor, then a threshold decides between the stored answer and a fallback.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should I split docs into sections first?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLM generate pairs from a doc?')
sendPrompt('What does admin review check before import?')
sendPrompt('Which sentence embedding model fits vi + en?')
sendPrompt('How do I set up pgvector storage and HNSW index?')
sendPrompt('How does /teach gap-fill into the vector store?')
sendPrompt('How should I normalize the query before embedding?')
sendPrompt('Why same embedding model on query and store?')
sendPrompt('How does nearest neighbor search work in pgvector?')
sendPrompt('How do I tune the similarity threshold?')
sendPrompt('How is the stored answer returned in tier 2?')
sendPrompt('What does tier 2 return when nothing passes threshold?')
